conclusion: Systematic S-shaped brightness-dependent mean-residual bias exists (max 0.0072, up to ~12pct of local noise std at low brightness). NOT explained by a simple linear E[M]!=1 effect (linear R2=0.81, insufficient). A cubic empirical correction captures it almost perfectly (R2=0.994), reducing residual-after-correction to <0.0007 everywhere (<0.6pct of noise std). Root physical mechanism not identified - documented as a known minor approximation with an empirical correction, same pattern as Phase 1 handling its own unexplained brightness-overprediction effect, rather than left unresolved.
